claims.statement: Automatic ASR, conservative interpretation, human acoustic review and factual validation are distinct states.
The A01 relational thesis is usable as an interpretative framework, but the audio does not establish that every relation is causal or that spacetime emergence has been physically proved.
A no-break chain claim is operational only relative to defined links and invariants; chain integrity does not imply semantic truth.
A03 is a lexical joke about taste, not the previously alleged parent-tax argument.
A04 is a first-person allegation about an unsupported persistence claim and intended legal action, not the previously assumed knowledge-versus-belief aphorism.
A false persistence output can be tested through logs and retrieval, but intent and legal liability are not established by the audio alone.
Past artifact to present reception to future consequence is compatible with ordinary forward causal models.
The uncertainty relation does not establish failure of relativistic light cones or past-directed signalling.
A06 is a wordplay around Steuer and not the previously assumed Genitive/wessen rule.
A07 is a practical-competence pun; its exact wording remains acoustically uncertified.
Physical retrocausality and mutation of past events are not established by this corpus.
No new EFFECT_ACK state, wire field, transition, priority rule or DONE predicate is introduced.
